parts.name: mattress_nem_lo_xo_160
sources: A mattress of 160 by 200 by 25 cm: its cover sewn from 4 pieces (World.Sewing.Cushion).
Mattresses of 120 and 160 by 200 cm, 5, 10 and 15 cm thick (Vạn Thành; Dunlopillo: 160 by 200 by 10 cm).
A cover of knitted ticking of polyester, 200 g/m2 (MH Chine: jacquard knitted mattress fabric; knitted tickings are 150 to 650 g/m2).
Foam of high resilience HR35, 35 kg/m3 (Onsen: 30 to 45 kg/m3 for the open cells of HR foam).
A unit of pocket coils, 45 kg/m3: a mattress of pocket coils 10 in thick is 35 to 40 kg in queen (Megafurniture: Somnuz).
Memory foam of 4 lb/ft3, 64 kg/m3 (Mattress Mick: 3 to 5 lb/ft3, 2 to 4 in thick).
